## Problem
What are you trying to do that the engine doesn't support today?

## Proposed solution
Describe the feature or API you'd like.

## Roadmap check
Have you checked [`ROADMAP.md`](../../ROADMAP.md)? If this maps to an existing milestone,
note which one (e.g. M2 CPN, M5 HCPN). If it's already planned, a 👍 on the relevant issue
may be more useful than a new one.

## Alternatives considered
Any workarounds or alternative designs you've thought about.

## Additional context
Links, references to other Petri-net / workflow tools, etc.
